verdict.rationale: Asana's API and app-component docs show broad coverage (task creation, rules, webhooks, app UI surfaces, published OpenAPI spec) suggesting most core PM workflows are scriptable, but there is no explicit claim of full UI/API parity, and newer AI-native surfaces (AI Studio, AI Teammates, Dash) are described only as UI features with no evidence of API-equivalent access. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, API coverage for AI Studio/Teammates/Dash, independent developer confirmation of full feature parity.
